Ben —

Thanks — I reviewed the comparison and re-ran the CS scoring with two customer cohorts (PLG SMB and enterprise support). Summary below (high level):

- Intercom: Score 86/100. Pros: in-app messaging, product-led automation, lower TCO for SMB play. Cons: lacks deep enterprise renewal orchestration; limited native Success analytics.
- Gainsight: Score 88/100. Pros: best fit for renewal play and health scoring at scale, granular playbooks. Cons: longer implementation and expensive onboarding/consulting.
- Zendesk: Score 75/100. Pros: mature ticketing, enterprise features. Cons: heavier to operate, overlaps with Intercom for simple conversational flows.

Must-haves that would block moving forward:
- A reliable SSO + SCIM provisioning path (all three vendors support this, verification required)
- Data residency/log retention terms for EU customers (Vivek to confirm compatibility)
- Clarity on audit logs and export for SOC2 evidence (legal asks)

Recommendation: prioritize Intercom + Gainsight in parallel. Intercom gets live comms quickly; Gainsight handles long-term retention/enterprise. Zendesk only if enterprise customers veto Intercom.

I attached my scoring export separately. I can have a short vendor requirements doc (2 pages) by EOD 11/28.

Laura
